sentences.t: The Gulf, a hair-trigger weekend: Iran's armed forces chief says the US Navy cannot re-enter the Gulf and will be targeted if it tries; President Trump says a strike could come "maybe tomorrow" - or a "big, beautiful" deal; the IRGC claims mines have hit more tankers as missiles keep hitting Saudi targets.
Brent closed Friday at $116.72, its highest since April.

SEBI's road map: tokenised corporate bonds under "Demat 2.0" - a pilot already live, secondary trading next - a short-selling review, graded broker compliance and responsible-AI guidelines being finalised.
Jio, the eve of allotment: BSE's own final demand schedule shows the issue 9.73 times subscribed on its platform, retail barely crossing full cover while institutions bid 33 times.
